notes: Source: Kumari et al., J Lab Physicians 2019;11:34-8, JPNATC AIIMS Delhi, 5-year surveillance 2012-2016. Table 1 (page 3) is the pooled antibiogram for Acinetobacter spp. (98.5% A. baumannii, 1.4% A. lwoffii, 0.1% A. hemolyticus), mapped whole table to Acinetobacter baumannii per the dominant species. Table prints yearly R counts(%), plus 'Total resistance (%)' and 'Total sensitive (%)' pooled columns. I used the printed 'Total sensitive (%)' column directly as s (from_R=false). Colistin is not in Table 1; text states only 68 (1.8%) of 3744 isolates were colistin resistant by VITEK 2, so s=98.2 (from_R=true), authors note these could not be retested by microbroth dilution. n=3744 total Acinetobacter isolates (28.9% of 16,210). Tigecycline was N/A in 2012 (pooled S from 2013-2016). Note: absolute counts in Table 1 sum to ~4680 (exceed 3744 isolates), likely a per-isolate-test tally inconsistency in the source; percentages are internally consistent and were used. Drugs NOT tested (per authors): ampicillin/sulbactam, minocycline, cefoperazone/sulbactam.
